bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears are gearing up for their 2026 season opener against the Carolina Panthers on Sunday, September 13, with head coach Ben Johnson confirming that veteran Braxton Jones will start Sunday's season opener against the Panthers at left tackle . Meanwhile, the injury report brought mixed news heading into Week 1, as receiver Luther Burden III is expected to play in Week 1 after recovering from the groin injury that kept him out of the preseason , while safety Xavier Woods is questionable and cornerback Rome Odunze continues working back from a calf issue.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions are gearing up for their Week 1 season opener against the New Orleans Saints, with storylines centering on quarterback Jared Goff, who has a chip on his shoulder entering 2026 , and a defense that has much to prove throughout the 2026 NFL season . Additional camp notes include continued development from young players like defensive tackle Skyler Gill-Howard, plus updates on second-year offensive lineman Tate Ratledge's progression and running back Sione Vaki's expanded role as Detroit prepares for its opener.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Packers are preparing for their season-opening showdown against the Minnesota Vikings on Sunday, with head coach Matt LaFleur addressing questions about running back Josh Jacobs after Jacobs appeared in court and was convicted of misdemeanor battery on Thursday. Matt LaFleur had already made his support for Josh Jacobs clear while the Green Bay Packers running back's legal case unfolded, and after Jacobs appeared in court Thursday, the Packers coach was given another opportunity to address the situation.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings and Green Bay Packers released their injury final reports, along with injury designations, after Friday's practice in advance of their Sunday afternoon matchup at US Bank Stadium . Ahead of the Week 1 clash, attention has also centered on quarterback Kyler Murray, as analysts note the Vikings enter the 2026 NFL season with plenty of optimism, but a major concern surrounds their new quarterback, whose ability to stay healthy and consistently perform could determine whether Minnesota's revamped offense reaches its potential or becomes a source of frustration .
